description: Create or overwrite one file on the remote device relative to $HOME, creating missing parent directories. content may be UTF-8 text or base64 and is limited to 16 MB.

device_id.description: IP address, hostname, MAC address, or device identifier of the target Raspberry Pi / SSH device.

path.description: Path relative to the authenticated user's remote $HOME directory.

name: pi_file_write
title: Write a file to a device
